Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1235

Rendering

  • The Render Queue: jobs in order, by priority, paused, removed or sent to render nodes.
  • Render nodes: other Macs and Linux boxes render a comp's frames, on a studio key (Settings > Preferences > Render). This Mac can be one too: never (the default), when idle, or always.

Nodes

  • A Roto whose layer is planar tracked follows the track, perspective and all.
  • Transform and CornerPin2D clamp; Reformat to box keeps the box's own pixel aspect; Radial's replace and opacity.
  • VariableBlur: a blur whose size follows a matte.
  • Time presets on TimeOffset and TimeWarp; expression presets and speed ramps.
  • Frame controls are typed fields; more of Nuke's menus are menus.
  • Each node's panel shows the controls Kento doesn't build yet, dim, with a note saying so.

Interface

  • Right-click menus in the Node Graph and the Viewer, from the menu bar's own items.
  • The Roto row: a button and a key for every tool; click inside a shape to pick it whole, drag to move it, Delete to remove it.
  • The Dope Sheet's right-click menu, and Delete takes the chosen keys out; the ruler scrubs the playhead in the Dope Sheet and Curve Editor.
  • Color sliders show the colors they make, on the color nodes, Review Grade and FilmLab; Grade's rows on one line.
  • FilmLab: its negative and print stocks as menus; saved grades import and export.
  • Preferences are filled in; the comp's sound is an AudioRead node.

The manual

  • Ten more drawings of the interface; chapters for the Render Queue and render nodes.

Not yet

  • FilmLab's own film engine (carried, not yet run); Flare's repeated flares; the Transitions window and Edit mode.

Kento Alpha 0.8, build 1188

Nodes, closer to the reference compositor

  • A Roto whose layer is planar tracked now follows the track, perspective and all: its shapes had been off away from the track's reference frame.
  • Transform and CornerPin2D clamp: negative values and the filter's ringing below 0 are cut, as the reference renders them.
  • Reformat to box keeps the box's own pixel aspect and the picture's proportions; to format keeps the format's pixel aspect.
  • Radial's replace and opacity.

The manual

  • Ten more drawings of the interface, one for each guide chapter that had none.
  • The transform jack's invert mark is at its lower right, as drawn.

Not yet

  • Flare's repeated flares; the Transitions window and Edit mode.
